notes: All 25 candidates read from their saved texts. Three program-list pages: two Berkeley IEOR department news posts giving job-market placements for the 2022 (6 names) and 2023 (7 names) doctoral cohorts (industrial engineering and operations research, an IEOR department rather than a business school; several placements are operations-management assistant professorships at business schools), and the University of Cincinnati Lindner 2022 Doctoral Notes page (6 recent PhD graduates with placements across all Lindner areas; only David Rea is OBAIS, the rest are marketing, finance and economics). The Berkeley IEOR "Ph.D. Dissertations" index (ieor.berkeley.edu/ph-d-dissertations/) holds no graduate names itself but links to per-year dissertation lists 1989-2017; it has 16 pages captured below it that may be worth a separate look. Several other pages do list named graduates with placements or theses but belong to departments outside operations/management (CU Boulder Integrative Physiology placements, CU Physics Education Research dissertations, CU Museum master's theses, Cambridge ESD MPhil dissertations) and were marked not-a-list per the brief. No institution-by-host corrections were needed.
